lines.text: Do not fret over evildoers, but trust in the LORD and delight in Him.
The evildoers will be cut off, but the meek will inherit the land.
The LORD upholds the righteous, but the wicked will vanish like chaff.
Turn away from evil and do good, for the LORD loves mercy and will not forsake His saints.
The LORD is the stronghold of the righteous and rescues them because they take refuge in Him.
